claim: ADR 0297 (AW02): INSIGHT_GENERATOR_VERSION is at least 11, and its history records version 11 as the 2026-10-05 glass-is-not-a-bottle change with 'A row below 11' as its refusal floor, so every stored row computed before it (which may hold a sentence counted in pours) is refused and recomputed. Drafted as 8; renumbered 9 on 2026-10-07 (main at 6, #619 holding 7, #625 holding 8), and 11 on 2026-10-08 at the re-sync onto origin/main be9a16ccf, because #652 took 10 on main. Renamed from AW02-GENERATOR-VERSION-9 on 2026-10-08. The number is re-checked at merge: of the open PRs that move it, whichever merges later must be above main's version at its merge. The check reads a version of 11 or more, so a later bump keeps it true, and fails on 10 or lower, on a lost ADR 0297 history line, or on a history line still numbered 9.
verify: python3 -c 'import sys,re;g=open("apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/insights/insight-generator.service.ts").read();m=re.search("export const INSIGHT_GENERATOR_VERSION = ([0-9]+);",g);h=re.search(r"[*] +11 \S 2026-10-05 [(]ADR 0297[)]: a glass is not a bottle[.]",g);sys.exit(0 if m and int(m.group(1))>=11 and h and "A row below 11 may hold a sentence" in g else 1)'
